capabilities: Open .xmind files in a dedicated Obsidian view
Search the current sheet and jump between matching topics
Expand and collapse branches while respecting saved fold state
Read maps in a full-page outliner hierarchy view
disambiguation: Not an XMind editor or mind-mapping tool; it only displays existing .xmind files and never modifies them.
extras: Read-only by design: it cannot create, edit, save, or export XMind files. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. UI is available in English and Simplified Chinese.
problem: Obsidian cannot open or display XMind mind map files, so .xmind files in a vault require switching to an external app.

relations.evidence: XMind Maps focuses on viewing. It reads the local .xmind package and displays common XMind structures

summary: Read-only viewer that opens local .xmind mind map files in Obsidian and embeds them in Markdown notes.
